wire.errors.sdk_spec.agent_identity_conf: agent_name and agent_id are mutually exclusive
wire.errors.sdk_spec.approval_declared_t: ApprovalPolicy.declared() must name at least one tool; use ApprovalPolicy.refuse() for an undeclared bound session
wire.errors.sdk_spec.approval_handler_wr: ApprovalPolicy.handler is only meaningful for mode ''callback'', not {mode}
wire.errors.sdk_spec.approval_tools_wron: ApprovalPolicy.tools is only meaningful for mode ''declared'', not {mode}
wire.errors.sdk_spec.attach_fields_unsup: mode=''attach'' opens a viewer for spec.resume; it does not attach teams, profiles, tools, names, goals or approval policies — that is the owner''s side. Set only resume on this spec (or use mode=''own''). Offending fields: {fields}.
wire.errors.sdk_spec.attach_output_unsup: output enforcement cannot be set on an attached session; the owning runtime decides
wire.errors.sdk_spec.attach_resume_requi: mode=''attach'' needs spec.resume: a viewer attaches to an id
wire.errors.sdk_spec.resume_empty: resume must be a session id or "@latest", not an empty string
wire.errors.sdk_spec.spawn_birth_effort_: birth_effort for a new spawned session rides the birth sample and needs the hosting/model pair alongside it; state all three, or open the session in-process (open_session) to set a birth level without a model pair.
wire.errors.sdk_spec.spawn_fields_unsupp: spawn_session() cannot deliver post-open state to a new runtime child; unsupported fields on this spec: {fields}. Open the session in-process (open_session), attach what you need, dispose, then spawn_session() the same id — resume restores the attachment; or spawn without these fields.
wire.errors.sdk_spec.spawn_model_pair_re: spawn_session() routes hosting/model to a NEW runtime as one birth sample; state both, or neither (the child then resolves its model from the root''s config).
wire.errors.sdk_spec.spawn_output_unsupp: spawn_session() cannot carry output enforcement ({fields}); open the session with open_session(..., mode=''own'') and engage it afterwards
wire.errors.sdk_spec.tools_empty: tools must name at least one tool; leave it None to stay unrestricted
wire.errors.sdk_spec.world_root_empty: world_root must be a non-empty path when set
wire.errors.sdk_spec.yolo_approval_unrea: yolo=True makes an ApprovalPolicy.{approval_mode}() gate unreachable; use ApprovalPolicy.auto() (or drop yolo) instead
